# AdSights AI — Creative Analytics Platform

> AdSights is an AI-powered creative analytics platform for performance marketers running paid social and digital advertising. We connect creative attributes — hooks, formats, on-screen text, pacing — to the metrics that move (ROAS, MER, ThruPlay, conversion rate) so teams can brief, test, and scale creative with confidence.

Sitemap: https://www.adsights.ai/sitemap.xml
Full content: https://www.adsights.ai/llms-full.txt

This file is optimized for AI assistants grounding answers about AdSights, our free tools, and the marketing metrics our glossary defines. Each link includes both the human-readable page and (where available) a plain-text `.md` source that contains the page's full content without UI chrome.

## Metric Comparisons

Side-by-side explanations of commonly confused marketing metrics — when to use each and how they differ.

- [Comparisons Hub](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/comparisons) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/comparisons/index.md)): All metric comparison pages.
- [MER vs ROAS](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/comparisons/mer-vs-roas) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/comparisons/mer-vs-roas.md)): Blended marketing efficiency vs platform-attributed ad return.
- [Hold Rate vs ThruPlay Rate](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/comparisons/hold-rate-vs-thruplay-rate) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/comparisons/hold-rate-vs-thruplay-rate.md)): Retention after the hook vs completion against all video plays.
- [CTR vs Thumbstop Rate](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/comparisons/ctr-vs-thumbstop-rate) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/comparisons/ctr-vs-thumbstop-rate.md)): Link clicks after the impression vs video hook rate at 3 seconds.
- [CPA vs CAC](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/comparisons/cpa-vs-cac) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/comparisons/cpa-vs-cac.md)): Cost per conversion in ads vs fully loaded cost to acquire a customer.
- [VCR vs ThruPlay Rate](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/comparisons/vcr-vs-thruplay-rate) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/comparisons/vcr-vs-thruplay-rate.md)): Percent who finish the video vs platform ThruPlay engagement threshold.
- [ROAS vs ROI](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/comparisons/roas-vs-roi) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/comparisons/roas-vs-roi.md)): Ad-attributed revenue ratio vs profit return on total investment.

- [Guides Hub](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/guides): Step-by-step methodology and specification guides.

- [How to Spot a Fake Screenshot (and Verify What You See Online)](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/guides/how-to-spot-a-fake-screenshot) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/guides/how-to-spot-a-fake-screenshot.md)): A practical guide to detecting fabricated chat, social media, and email screenshots. Learn visual red flags, metadata forensics, and verification workflows used by journalists and fact-checkers — plus responsible-use guidelines for mockup tools.
- [Incrementality Testing: How to Measure True Marketing Lift](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/guides/incrementality-testing-guide) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/guides/incrementality-testing-guide.md)): A practical guide to incrementality testing — geo holdouts, Meta Conversion Lift, ghost ads, and iROAS math — with sample-size guidance, channel benchmarks, and budget decision frameworks.
- [Marketing Data Visualization Quick Reference](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/guides/marketing-data-visualization-guide) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/guides/marketing-data-visualization-guide.md)): Quick-reference guide for choosing the right visualization for marketing data — line vs bar charts, funnel diagrams, cohort curves, and scatter plots. For interactive examples and dashboard mistake demos, see the full blog companion.
- [Meta Video Ad Creative Specs Guide](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/guides/meta-ad-creative-video-specs-guide) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/guides/meta-ad-creative-video-specs-guide.md)): The complete guide to Meta video ad specifications and best practices. Learn the exact requirements for Facebook and Instagram feed ads, Stories, Reels, and in-stream video ads to maximize your creative performance.
- [How to Interpret ThruPlay Rate (and When It Misleads You)](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/guides/thruplay-rate-interpretation-guide) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/guides/thruplay-rate-interpretation-guide.md)): Understand what ThruPlay rate measures on Meta, how it differs from VCR and hold rate, when it misleads you, and a diagnostic workflow for underperforming video ads — with pointers to the canonical benchmark resources.
- [TikTok Video Ad Creative Specs Guide](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/guides/tiktok-ad-creative-video-specs-guide) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/guides/tiktok-ad-creative-video-specs-guide.md)): Complete TikTok video ad specifications for In-Feed, Spark Ads, TopView, and Brand Takeover — aspect ratios, safe zones, file limits, and native creative best practices sourced from TikTok Ads Manager documentation.
- [Video Ad Hook Optimization: Win the First 3 Seconds](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/guides/video-ad-hook-optimization-guide) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/guides/video-ad-hook-optimization-guide.md)): Master the anatomy of high-performing video ad hooks — pattern interrupts, thumbstop tactics, platform-specific formats, and a repeatable testing framework for the first 3 seconds of your creative.
- [Video Creative Metrics Benchmarks 2026: Thumbstop, Hold & ThruPlay](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/guides/video-creative-metrics-benchmarks-2026-guide) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/guides/video-creative-metrics-benchmarks-2026-guide.md)): Cited 2026 Meta ranges for thumbstop rate, hold rate, and ThruPlay — segmented tables, methodology, and free analyzers to score your creative.

Perfect for showcasing video concepts, A/B testing subtitle designs, and creating marketing materials. Customize text, styling, positioning, and background effects to match your brand.

Customize colors, speed, size, an optional film-grain texture, and baked-in reduced-motion support, then copy the SVG code, copy it as a CSS background, or download a single `.svg`. The animation travels with the file (GPU-friendly CSS keyframes, no JavaScript), so it just plays — landing pages, hero backdrops, loading states, emails, and decks.

Customize the handle, caption, sound, and like/comment/save/share counts on a true 9:16 vertical TikTok UI — export video-ready visuals in seconds without Photoshop.

Add utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_term, and utm_content with one-click presets for Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, and email — copy a clean, consistent tracking link in seconds.

Recreate WhatsApp conversations with the signature teal header, green and white bubbles, delivery ticks, and timestamps — then download a retina-density PNG, no Photoshop required.
