## Marketing Glossary

Plain-language definitions of the metrics our audience asks AI assistants about. Each `.md` file contains the full definition, formula, benchmarks by segment, and FAQs.

- [Glossary Hub](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary.md)): 250+ defined terms covering metrics, creative analytics, platform KPIs, and chart types.

### Metrics

- [Activation Rate](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/activation-rate) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/activation-rate.md)): The percentage of new sign-ups that reach a defined first-value milestone (the activation event).
- [Ad Frequency](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/ad-frequency) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/ad-frequency.md)): The average number of times a unique user is exposed to an ad.
- [Add-to-Cart Rate](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/add-to-cart-rate) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/add-to-cart-rate.md)): The percentage of product page views or interactions that result in an add-to-cart event, typically on e-commerce sites.
- [Annual Recurring Revenue](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/annual-recurring-revenue-arr) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/annual-recurring-revenue-arr.md)): The normalized, annualized value of a subscription business's recurring revenue, excluding one-time fees.
- [Anomaly Detection](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/anomaly-detection) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/anomaly-detection.md)): The systematic process of identifying data points that significantly deviate from expected patterns and thresholds.
- [Attributed Marketing Efficiency Ratio](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/attributed-marketing-efficiency-ratio-amer) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/attributed-marketing-efficiency-ratio-amer.md)): Revenue attributed to paid marketing divided by total marketing spend.
- [Average Order Value](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/average-order-value-aov) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/average-order-value-aov.md)): A key e-commerce metric measuring the average monetary value of each completed transaction.
- [Blended Customer Acquisition Cost](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/blended-customer-acquisition-cost) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/blended-customer-acquisition-cost.md)): Total marketing spend divided by total new customers acquired across all channels — the holistic, attribution-agnostic counterpart to platform-reported CAC.
- [Bounce Rate](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/bounce-rate) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/bounce-rate.md)): Percentage of single-page sessions where users exit without meaningful interaction.
- [Churn Rate](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/churn-rate-cr) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/churn-rate-cr.md)): Percentage of customers who stop using a product or service during a given time period.
- [Click-Through Rate](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/click-through-rate-ctr) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/click-through-rate-ctr.md)): The percentage of ad impressions that result in a click.
- [Confidence Interval](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/confidence-interval) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/confidence-interval.md)): Range of values likely to contain the true population parameter.
- [Control Group](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/control-group) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/control-group.md)): A segment of users or data points that receive no treatment or intervention, serving as a baseline for comparison in experiments.
- [Conversion Rate](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/conversion-rate) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/conversion-rate.md)): The percentage of users who complete a desired conversion action.
- [Cost Per Acquisition](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/cost-per-acquisition-cpa) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/cost-per-acquisition-cpa.md)): The average cost to acquire a customer or generate a full conversion.
- [Cost Per Action](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/cost-per-action-cpa) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/cost-per-action-cpa.md)): The average cost to drive a specific user action or micro-conversion.
- [Cost Per Click](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/cost-per-click-cpc) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/cost-per-click-cpc.md)): The average cost paid for each click on an advertisement.
- [Cost Per Completed View](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/cost-per-completed-view-cpcv) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/cost-per-completed-view-cpcv.md)): Average cost paid for each full video view completion (100% viewed).
- [Cost Per Mille](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/cost-per-mille-cpm) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/cost-per-mille-cpm.md)): The cost to deliver 1,000 ad impressions to target audience.
- [Cost Per ThruPlay](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/cost-per-thruplay) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/cost-per-thruplay.md)): Average cost of achieving a ThruPlay (complete view or 15-second watch) for video ads.
- [Cost Per View](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/cost-per-view-cpv) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/cost-per-view-cpv.md)): The average cost paid for each qualified video view based on platform-specific view criteria.
- [Customer Acquisition Cost](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/customer-acquisition-cost-cac) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/customer-acquisition-cost-cac.md)): The total business cost required to convert a prospect into a paying customer.
- [Customer Lifetime Value](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/customer-lifetime-value-clv) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/customer-lifetime-value-clv.md)): The predicted total revenue a business expects from a customer throughout their relationship.
- [Customer Retention Rate](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/customer-retention-rate-crr) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/customer-retention-rate-crr.md)): Percentage of existing customers who remain active with a business over a given time period.
- [Engagement Rate](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/engagement-rate) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/engagement-rate.md)): The percentage of users who interact with content through measurable actions relative to total reach or impressions.
- [Exponential Moving Average](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/exponential-moving-average-ema) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/exponential-moving-average-ema.md)): Weighted moving average giving more importance to recent data.
- [False Negative](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/false-negative) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/false-negative.md)): An error where a test incorrectly indicates the absence of a condition when it is actually present.
- [False Positive](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/false-positive) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/false-positive.md)): An error in data analysis where a test incorrectly indicates the presence of a condition or effect that is not actually present.
- [First-Time Impression Ratio](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/first-time-impression-ratio) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/first-time-impression-ratio.md)): The percentage of ad impressions that are shown to users who have never seen the ad before.
- [Hold Rate](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/hold-rate) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/hold-rate.md)): Percentage of hooked viewers (3-second video views) who keep watching to the 15-second mark.
- [Impressions](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/impressions) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/impressions.md)): The total number of times an ad is displayed to users.
- [Initiate Checkout Rate](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/initiate-checkout-rate) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/initiate-checkout-rate.md)): The percentage of shopping sessions that begin the checkout process, with definitions that can vary by context.
- [Margin of Error](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/margin-of-error) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/margin-of-error.md)): Maximum expected difference between sample estimate and true value. A measure of the precision of a sample estimate.
- [Marketing Efficiency Ratio](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/marketing-efficiency-ratio-mer) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/marketing-efficiency-ratio-mer.md)): Total revenue divided by total marketing spend, measuring overall marketing effectiveness.
- [Monthly Recurring Revenue](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/monthly-recurring-revenue-mrr) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/monthly-recurring-revenue-mrr.md)): The normalized total of predictable subscription revenue a business earns each month.
- [Moving Average](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/moving-average) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/moving-average.md)): Rolling calculation that smooths data fluctuations over time.
- [Net Promoter Score](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/net-promoter-score-nps) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/net-promoter-score-nps.md)): A customer-loyalty index, from −100 to +100, based on how likely customers are to recommend a brand.
- [Net Revenue Retention](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/net-revenue-retention-nrr) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/net-revenue-retention-nrr.md)): The percentage of recurring revenue retained from existing customers over a period, including expansion and net of churn.
- [New Customer Acquisition Cost](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/new-customer-acquisition-cost-ncac) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/new-customer-acquisition-cost-ncac.md)): Cost specifically to acquire first-time customers.
- [New Marketing Efficiency Ratio](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/new-marketing-efficiency-ratio-nmer) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/new-marketing-efficiency-ratio-nmer.md)): Revenue from new customers divided by marketing spend, measuring acquisition efficiency.
- [Overfitting](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/overfitting) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/overfitting.md)): A modeling error where an algorithm learns the training data too precisely, capturing noise rather than underlying patterns, resulting in poor performance on new data.
- [Pay-Per-Click](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/pay-per-click-ppc) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/pay-per-click-ppc.md)): An advertising model where advertisers pay only when users click their ads.
- [Population Mean](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/population-mean) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/population-mean.md)): The average value of a variable across an entire population, representing the central tendency of the complete dataset.
- [Reach](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/reach) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/reach.md)): The number of unique users exposed to an advertisement.
- [Return on Ad Spend](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/return-on-ad-spend-roas) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/return-on-ad-spend-roas.md)): A performance metric measuring revenue generated relative to advertising spend.
- [Return on Investment](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/return-on-investment-roi) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/return-on-investment-roi.md)): Net profit or loss generated relative to total investment cost, expressed as a percentage.
- [Rule of 40](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/rule-of-40) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/rule-of-40.md)): A SaaS health benchmark stating that revenue growth rate plus profit margin should exceed 40%.
- [Sample Size](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/sample-size) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/sample-size.md)): The number of observations in a sample, critical for the accuracy and reliability of statistical estimates.
- [Session Duration](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/session-duration) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/session-duration.md)): The length of time a user spends actively engaged during a single website visit.
- [Share of Voice](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/share-of-voice-sov) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/share-of-voice-sov.md)): Percentage of market presence across advertising, social media, and PR relative to total market or competitors.
- [Standard Deviation](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/standard-deviation) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/standard-deviation.md)): Measure of variability or dispersion in advertising performance metrics.
- [Statistical Significance](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/statistical-significance) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/statistical-significance.md)): Measure of whether results are likely due to chance or a real difference.
- [ThruPlay](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/thruplay) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/thruplay.md)): Meta's video-view event: a play watched to 15 seconds, or completed if the video is under 15 seconds.
- [ThruPlay Rate](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/thruplay-rate) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/thruplay-rate.md)): Percentage of video plays that result in complete views or 15-second watches.
- [Thumbstop Click Rate](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/thumbstop-click-rate) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/thumbstop-click-rate.md)): Percentage of users who click after meaningfully pausing to view content.
- [Thumbstop Rate](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/thumbstop-rate-tsr) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/thumbstop-rate-tsr.md)): Percentage of users who pause scrolling to view content for a meaningful duration.
- [Variance](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/variance) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/variance.md)): The average of the squared differences from the mean.
- [Video Completion Rate](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/video-completion-rate-vcr) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/video-completion-rate-vcr.md)): The percentage of video ad impressions where users watch to completion (100%).
- [View Rate](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/view-rate) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/view-rate.md)): Percentage of video ad impressions that result in views meeting platform-specific duration thresholds.
- [View Through Rate](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/view-through-rate-vtr) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/view-through-rate-vtr.md)): Share of ad impressions that become platform-counted views — VTR = (counted views ÷ impressions) × 100; in attribution contexts, the share of impressions that led to post-view conversions.
- [Viral Coefficient](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/viral-coefficient-k-factor) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/metrics/viral-coefficient-k-factor.md)): The average number of new users each existing user generates through invitations and referrals.

### Creative Concepts

- [A/B Testing](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/ab-testing) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/ab-testing.md)): Controlled experimentation comparing two ad variants that differ by exactly one element to measure its impact.
- [Ad Copy](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/ad-copy) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/ad-copy.md)): Persuasive text content created specifically for advertising campaigns.
- [Ad Iterations](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/ad-iterations) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/ad-iterations.md)): Strategic variations built upon proven successful ad creative to incrementally optimize performance.
- [Ad Variations](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/ad-variations) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/ad-variations.md)): Systematically designed creative variants used for testing and audience targeting optimization.
- [Ads as Code](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/ads-as-code) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/ads-as-code.md)): An ad-production approach where creative is defined as parameterized code templates and rendered programmatically, rather than built in design tools.
- [AI-Generated Creative](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/ai-generated-creative) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/ai-generated-creative.md)): Ad creative — copy, images, video, audio, or full compositions — produced wholly or partly by generative AI models.
- [Animation](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/animation) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/animation.md)): The technique of creating motion and visual change through sequential frames or programmatic transitions.
- [Automated Campaign Management](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/automated-campaign-management) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/automated-campaign-management.md)): AI-driven systems that autonomously optimize ad campaigns by dynamically adjusting creative, budgets, and targeting.
- [Banner Ads](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/banner-ads) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/banner-ads.md)): Standard display advertising format using static or animated images in fixed placements.
- [Brand Guidelines](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/brand-guidelines) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/brand-guidelines.md)): Comprehensive standards defining brand identity, voice, and creative execution.
- [Brand Messaging](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/brand-messaging) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/brand-messaging.md)): The core communication strategy used to convey a brand's value proposition and identity.
- [Branded Content](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/branded-content) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/branded-content.md)): High-value content that subtly integrates brand messaging while prioritizing audience value.
- [Call to Action](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/call-to-action-cta) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/call-to-action-cta.md)): A prompt in ad creative that encourages viewers to take a specific action.
- [Campaign Strategy](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/campaign-strategy) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/campaign-strategy.md)): Comprehensive plan defining campaign objectives, audience targeting, and execution approach.
- [Collection Ads](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/collection-ads) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/collection-ads.md)): Mobile-first ad format combining hero content with instant product shopping experiences.
- [Concept Testing](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/concept-testing) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/concept-testing.md)): Evaluation of creative concepts to predict audience response before full production.
- [Content Marketing](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/content-marketing) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/content-marketing.md)): Strategic marketing approach focused on creating and distributing valuable content to attract and retain audiences.
- [Conversational Marketing](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/conversational-marketing) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/conversational-marketing.md)): Real-time, dialogue-driven engagement strategy using chatbots, messaging apps, and live chat.
- [Creative Analysis](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-analysis) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-analysis.md)): Evaluating creative effectiveness based on performance metrics.
- [Creative Automation](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-automation) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-automation.md)): Software-driven production of ad creative at scale using templates and structured data instead of one-off manual design.
- [Creative Best Practices](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-best-practices) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-best-practices.md)): Evidence-based guidelines for creating high-performing ad creative across platforms.
- [Creative Brief](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-brief) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-brief.md)): Strategic document aligning creative development with campaign objectivae,'s and audience insights, or ad creative concepts.
- [Creative Consistency](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-consistency) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-consistency.md)): Maintaining uniform brand presentation across all advertising touchpoints.
- [Creative Fatigue](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-fatigue) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-fatigue.md)): The measurable decline in ad performance metrics as audiences become overexposed to creative assets.
- [Creative Hooks](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-hooks) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-hooks.md)): Strategic attention-grabbing elements that create immediate interest and drive deeper engagement.
- [Creative Management Platform](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-management-platform-cmp) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-management-platform-cmp.md)): Cloud software for producing, versioning, distributing, and measuring digital ad creative at scale from templates.
- [Creative Operations](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-operations) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-operations.md)): The discipline of managing the people, processes, and systems that produce creative work at scale — intake, workflow, approvals, assets, and tooling.
- [Creative Optimization](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-optimization) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-optimization.md)): Data-driven process of improving ad creative performance through systematic testing, analysis, and iteration.
- [Creative Refresh](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-refresh) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-refresh.md)): Strategic updates to ad creative that combat performance decay while preserving proven elements.
- [Creative Rotation](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-rotation) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-rotation.md)): Strategic cycling of multiple ad variations to optimize performance and prevent audience fatigue.
- [Creative Strategy](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-strategy) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-strategy.md)): The systematic approach to developing and executing creative that achieves specific marketing objectives.
- [Creative Testing](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-testing) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-testing.md)): The systematic process of evaluating ad creative variations to identify optimal performance through controlled experiments.
- [Creative Versioning](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-versioning) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creative-versioning.md)): Producing many tailored variants of a master ad creative — by size, placement, language, market, or segment — while preserving the core concept.
- [Creator-Generated Content](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creator-generated-content-cgc) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/creator-generated-content-cgc.md)): Content produced through formal partnerships between brands and professional creators/influencers.
- [Credibility Appeal (Ethos)](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/credibility-appeal) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/credibility-appeal.md)): Strategic persuasion technique establishing trust through verified expertise, authority, and demonstrated reliability.
- [Dark Posts](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/dark-posts) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/dark-posts.md)): Sponsored social media content that appears only to targeted audiences without publishing to the account's organic feed.
- [Data-Driven Creative](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/data-driven-creative) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/data-driven-creative.md)): Creative strategy informed by data and performance insights.
- [Design Principles](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/design-principles) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/design-principles.md)): Fundamental rules and concepts that guide effective visual communication in advertising.
- [Direct Response Advertising](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/direct-response-advertising) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/direct-response-advertising.md)): Advertising designed to elicit immediate, measurable actions from the target audience.
- [Display Advertising](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/display-advertising) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/display-advertising.md)): Visual advertisements shown on websites and apps.
- [Dynamic Creative](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/dynamic-creative) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/dynamic-creative.md)): Advanced ad technology automatically combining and optimizing creative elements for personalized experiences.
- [End Cards](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/end-cards) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/end-cards.md)): Interactive video overlays that appear at content completion to drive engagement and conversion.
- [In-Feed Ads](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/in-feed-ads) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/in-feed-ads.md)): Advertisements seamlessly integrated into content feeds and streams.
- [In-Stream Ads](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/in-stream-ads) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/in-stream-ads.md)): Video advertisements that play before, during, or after streaming video content.
- [Information Architecture](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/information-architecture) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/information-architecture.md)): The structural design of information spaces and content hierarchies in digital advertising.
- [Message Ads](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/message-ads) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/message-ads.md)): Sponsored messages that initiate conversations through messaging platforms.
- [Mid-Roll Ads](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/mid-roll-ads) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/mid-roll-ads.md)): Video advertisements strategically placed during natural breaks in streaming content.
- [Motion Graphics](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/motion-graphics) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/motion-graphics.md)): The art of animating graphic design elements to create dynamic visual communication.
- [Multi-Variate Testing](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/multi-variate-testing) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/multi-variate-testing.md)): Advanced testing methodology examining interactions between multiple creative elements to identify optimal combinations.
- [Native Advertising](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/native-advertising) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/native-advertising.md)): Advertisements designed to blend seamlessly with platform content.
- [Objection Handling](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/objection-handling) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/objection-handling.md)): Strategic approach to addressing and overcoming customer concerns in marketing and sales communications.
- [Organic Content](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/organic-content) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/organic-content.md)): Content that gains visibility through natural audience engagement rather than paid promotion.
- [Pattern Interruption](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/pattern-interruption) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/pattern-interruption.md)): A creative tactic used to capture attention by breaking expected patterns.
- [Performance Creative](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/performance-creative) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/performance-creative.md)): Data-driven creative assets designed and optimized to achieve specific, measurable business outcomes.
- [Persona Development](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/persona-development) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/persona-development.md)): Creating detailed audience profiles to guide ad creative.
- [Post-Roll Ads](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/post-roll-ads) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/post-roll-ads.md)): Video advertisements that play after content completion, optimized for conversion actions.
- [Pre-Roll Ads](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/pre-roll-ads) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/pre-roll-ads.md)): Video advertisements that play before the main video content.
- [Programmatic Creative](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/programmatic-creative) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/programmatic-creative.md)): The application of automation and data to producing and assembling ad creative itself, as distinct from programmatic media buying.
- [Render](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/render) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/render.md)): Computer-generated imagery created through digital rendering processes.
- [Retargeting Creative](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/retargeting-creative) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/retargeting-creative.md)): Ad creative strategically designed to re-engage users based on their previous brand interactions and behaviors.
- [Rich Media](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/rich-media) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/rich-media.md)): Advanced display ad formats featuring interactive elements, video, and expandable capabilities.
- [Scroll-Stopping](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/scroll-stopping) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/scroll-stopping.md)): Creative techniques designed to halt users' rapid content consumption behaviors.
- [Short-Form Video](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/short-form-video) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/short-form-video.md)): Brief, engaging video content optimized for mobile and social platforms.
- [Social Proof](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/social-proof) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/social-proof.md)): Psychological principle where people validate decisions through the demonstrated experiences and behaviors of others.
- [Social Proof Ads](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/social-proof-ads) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/social-proof-ads.md)): Ad creative that strategically incorporates authentic customer validation through testimonials, reviews, or social metrics.
- [Split Testing](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/split-testing) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/split-testing.md)): Systematic experimentation methods for comparing ad creative variations to identify optimal performers.
- [Targeted Messaging](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/targeted-messaging) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/targeted-messaging.md)): Customized ad messaging tailored to specific audience segments and contexts.
- [Testimonial](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/testimonial) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/testimonial.md)): Authentic customer statements sharing specific experiences and results with a product or service.
- [Thumb-Stopping Creative](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/thumb-stopping-creative) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/thumb-stopping-creative.md)): Ad creative strategically designed to halt users' scrolling behavior through powerful visual impact.
- [Unboxing](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/unboxing) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/unboxing.md)): Content format documenting the authentic first experience of opening and discovering a new product.
- [User-Generated Content](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/user-generated-content-ugc) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/user-generated-content-ugc.md)): Authentic content created voluntarily by customers and brand advocates without direct compensation.
- [Vertical Video Ads](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/vertical-video-ads) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/vertical-video-ads.md)): Full-screen video ads optimized for mobile viewing in 9:16 aspect ratio.
- [Video Advertising](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/video-advertising) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/video-advertising.md)): Digital advertising format using video content to engage audiences across platforms and devices.
- [Visual Hierarchy](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/visual-hierarchy) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/visual-hierarchy.md)): The arrangement of visual elements to guide viewer attention in ad creative.
- [Visual Identity](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/visual-identity) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/visual-identity.md)): The distinct visual elements and style that define a brand's appearance.
- [Whitelisting](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/whitelisting) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/creative/whitelisting.md)): Permission-based advertising arrangement allowing brands to run ads through creator or influencer accounts.

### General Concepts

- [Account-Based Marketing](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/account-based-marketing-abm) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/account-based-marketing-abm.md)): Strategic B2B marketing approach targeting high-value accounts as individual markets.
- [Agentic Workflow](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/agentic-workflow) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/agentic-workflow.md)): A multi-step process carried out by AI agents that plan, use tools, and adapt to intermediate results with defined human checkpoints.
- [Attribution Window](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/attribution-window) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/attribution-window.md)): The time period during which marketing touchpoints are credited for conversions.
- [Audience Insights](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/audience-insights) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/audience-insights.md)): Data-driven understanding of audience characteristics, behaviors, and preferences.
- [Audience Segmentation](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/audience-segmentation) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/audience-segmentation.md)): Process of dividing audiences into distinct groups based on shared characteristics and behaviors.
- [Audience Targeting](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/audience-targeting) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/audience-targeting.md)): Strategic approach to reaching specific audience segments with tailored marketing messages.
- [Behavioral Targeting](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/behavioral-targeting) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/behavioral-targeting.md)): Advertising technique that uses user behavior data to deliver personalized ads and content.
- [Bottom-of-Funnel](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/bottom-of-funnel-bofu) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/bottom-of-funnel-bofu.md)): The decision and conversion stage of the marketing funnel where prospects are ready to make a purchase decision.
- [Brand Awareness](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/brand-awareness) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/brand-awareness.md)): The extent to which consumers recognize and recall a brand and correctly link it to its product category.
- [Brand Equity](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/brand-equity) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/brand-equity.md)): The commercial and perceptual value a brand holds as an asset, beyond the functional value of its products.
- [Brand Marketing](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/brand-marketing) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/brand-marketing.md)): Marketing activities focused on building and strengthening brand awareness and perception.
- [Brand Positioning](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/brand-positioning) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/brand-positioning.md)): Strategic placement of a brand in the market relative to competitors.
- [Brand Strategy](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/brand-strategy) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/brand-strategy.md)): Long-term plan for developing a successful brand to achieve business objectives.
- [Branding](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/branding) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/branding.md)): The process of creating and maintaining a distinct brand identity.
- [Business-to-Business](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/business-to-business-b2b) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/business-to-business-b2b.md)): Marketing and selling products/services to other businesses.
- [Business-to-Consumer](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/business-to-consumer-b2c) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/business-to-consumer-b2c.md)): Marketing and selling products/services directly to consumers.
- [Conversion Funnel](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/conversion-funnel) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/conversion-funnel.md)): Visual representation of the customer journey from initial awareness to final conversion, showing how prospects progress through each stage.
- [Conversion Rate Optimization](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/conversion-rate-optimization-cro) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/conversion-rate-optimization-cro.md)): Systematic process of improving ad creative and user experience to increase conversion rates.
- [Conversion Tracking](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/conversion-tracking) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/conversion-tracking.md)): The systematic measurement and analysis of user actions that indicate business value.
- [Custom Audiences](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/custom-audiences) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/custom-audiences.md)): Targeted audience segments created from first-party data and platform capabilities.
- [Customer Data Platform](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/customer-data-platform-cdp) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/customer-data-platform-cdp.md)): Unified customer database that collects, cleanses, and connects customer data from multiple sources.
- [Customer Journey](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/customer-journey) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/customer-journey.md)): The complete path of interactions between a customer and brand across all touchpoints, from initial awareness through post-purchase engagement.
- [Customer Lifecycle](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/customer-lifecycle) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/customer-lifecycle.md)): The progression of steps a customer goes through when considering, purchasing, using, and maintaining loyalty to a product or service.
- [Customer Relationship Management](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/customer-relationship-management-crm) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/customer-relationship-management-crm.md)): Comprehensive system and processes for managing customer relationships, marketing automation, and personalized engagement across the customer lifecycle.
- [Data-Driven Attribution](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/data-driven-attribution) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/data-driven-attribution.md)): A machine-learning attribution methodology that assigns fractional credit to each touchpoint based on observed conversion-path patterns — Google's default model in Google Ads and GA4 since 2023.
- [Demand Generation](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/demand-generation) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/demand-generation.md)): Strategic marketing focused on creating awareness and demand for products/services.
- [Designated Market Area](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/designated-market-area) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/designated-market-area.md)): Geographic regions defined by Nielsen that represent specific television markets where the population receives similar TV, radio, and media content.
- [Direct-to-Consumer](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/direct-to-consumer-dtc) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/direct-to-consumer-dtc.md)): Business model selling products directly to end consumers, bypassing traditional intermediaries.
- [Earned Media](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/earned-media) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/earned-media.md)): Brand exposure gained through organic sharing and word-of-mouth.
- [E-Commerce](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/ecommerce) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/ecommerce.md)): Digital buying and selling of goods and services through online platforms and marketplaces.
- [First-Party Data](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/first-party-data) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/first-party-data.md)): Data collected directly from customer interactions and owned channels.
- [Free Trial](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/free-trial) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/free-trial.md)): A time-limited offer giving prospects full or near-full product access to experience value before buying.
- [Freemium](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/freemium) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/freemium.md)): A pricing model offering a permanently free tier alongside paid upgrades for advanced features or capacity.
- [Growth Loops](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/growth-loops) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/growth-loops.md)): Self-reinforcing systems where the output of one user's actions becomes the input that drives new users.
- [Ideal Customer Profile](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/ideal-customer-profile-icp) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/ideal-customer-profile-icp.md)): A description of the company that gets the most value from your product and gives the most value back.
- [Incrementality](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/incrementality) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/incrementality.md)): Measurement methodology that isolates and quantifies the true causal impact of marketing activities by comparing against a baseline.
- [Incrementality Testing](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/incrementality-testing) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/incrementality-testing.md)): The experimental practice of measuring the true causal lift of marketing activity by comparing exposed and unexposed groups — geo holdouts, conversion lift studies, switchback tests and related designs.
- [Influencer Marketing](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/influencer-marketing) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/influencer-marketing.md)): Individual with the ability to affect purchase decisions of others through social media.
- [Key Performance Indicator](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/key-performance-indicator-kpi) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/key-performance-indicator-kpi.md)): Critical metrics that measure success against strategic business objectives.
- [Landing Page Optimization](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/landing-page-optimization-lpo) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/landing-page-optimization-lpo.md)): Strategic refinement of post-click landing pages to maximize conversion rates and ROI.
- [Lead Generation](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/lead-generation) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/lead-generation.md)): Process of attracting and converting prospects into potential customers.
- [Lead Nurturing](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/lead-nurturing) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/lead-nurturing.md)): Strategic process of developing and maintaining relationships with leads through personalized content and interactions.
- [Marketing Attribution](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/marketing-attribution) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/marketing-attribution.md)): The process of identifying and assigning credit to marketing touchpoints that lead to conversions within defined time windows.
- [Marketing Automation](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/marketing-automation) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/marketing-automation.md)): Technology and processes for automating marketing activities and personalized customer communications at scale.
- [Marketing Funnel](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/marketing-funnel) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/marketing-funnel.md)): Strategic framework mapping the customer journey from initial brand awareness through purchase and advocacy.
- [Marketing Mix Modeling](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/marketing-mix-modeling) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/marketing-mix-modeling.md)): Statistical analysis to measure marketing tactics' impact on sales.
- [Marketing Qualified Lead](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/marketing-qualified-lead-mql) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/marketing-qualified-lead-mql.md)): A lead whose engagement and fit signals indicate higher likelihood to become a customer, ready to be nurtured toward sales.
- [Media Buying](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/media-buying) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/media-buying.md)): Execution of media plans through direct negotiation and platform-based buying.
- [Media Planning](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/media-planning) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/media-planning.md)): Strategic process of determining optimal media mix and investment across traditional and digital channels.
- [Middle-of-Funnel](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/middle-of-funnel-mofu) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/middle-of-funnel-mofu.md)): The consideration and evaluation stage of the marketing funnel where prospects research potential solutions to their identified needs.
- [North Star Metric](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/north-star-metric) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/north-star-metric.md)): The single metric that best captures the core value a product delivers to its customers.
- [Over-the-Top](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/over-the-top-ott) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/over-the-top-ott.md)): Streaming media services delivered directly to viewers via the internet, bypassing traditional distribution.
- [Owned Media](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/owned-media) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/owned-media.md)): Marketing channels and assets directly controlled by a brand.
- [Paid Media](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/paid-media) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/paid-media.md)): Marketing channels and placements that require direct payment for exposure.
- [Platform Advertising](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/platform-advertising) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/platform-advertising.md)): Direct advertising through major digital platform interfaces.
- [Product Catalog](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/product-catalog) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/product-catalog.md)): Platform-specific database of product information used for advertising and commerce.
- [Product Feed](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/product-feed) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/product-feed.md)): Structured data file containing product information for e-commerce advertising.
- [Product-Led Growth](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/product-led-growth-plg) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/product-led-growth-plg.md)): A go-to-market strategy where the product itself drives acquisition, conversion, expansion, and retention.
- [Product-Market Fit](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/product-market-fit-pmf) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/product-market-fit-pmf.md)): The degree to which a product satisfies strong demand in a good market.
- [Product-Qualified Lead](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/product-qualified-lead-pql) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/product-qualified-lead-pql.md)): A lead qualified by hands-on product usage that signals strong buying intent, native to product-led growth.
- [Programmatic Advertising](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/programmatic-advertising) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/programmatic-advertising.md)): Automated buying and selling of digital advertising inventory through real-time bidding platforms.
- [Remarketing](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/remarketing) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/remarketing.md)): Targeted advertising to users who have previously engaged with a brand.
- [Retargeting](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/retargeting) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/retargeting.md)): Targeting ads to users who have previously interacted with a brand.
- [Retention Marketing](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/retention-marketing) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/retention-marketing.md)): Marketing strategies focused on keeping and growing existing customer relationships.
- [Sales-Led Growth](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/sales-led-growth) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/sales-led-growth.md)): A go-to-market strategy where human sales teams drive acquisition and conversion through outreach, demos, and negotiated deals.
- [Sales-Qualified Lead](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/sales-qualified-lead-sql) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/sales-qualified-lead-sql.md)): A prospective customer that has been evaluated and deemed ready for direct sales outreach.
- [Search Engine Marketing](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/search-engine-marketing) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/search-engine-marketing.md)): Paid advertising strategy focused on increasing visibility in search engine results pages through targeted keyword bidding and ad placements.
- [Social Commerce](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/social-commerce) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/social-commerce.md)): Integration of e-commerce functionality within social media platforms.
- [Third-Party Data](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/third-party-data) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/third-party-data.md)): External data acquired from providers to enhance audience targeting and insights.
- [Time to Value](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/time-to-value-ttv) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/time-to-value-ttv.md)): The elapsed time from a user's first engagement to the moment they first experience the product's core value.
- [Top-of-Funnel](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/top-of-funnel-tofu) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/top-of-funnel-tofu.md)): The initial awareness stage of the marketing funnel where prospects first discover a brand, product, or solution.
- [Total Addressable Market](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/total-addressable-market-tam) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/total-addressable-market-tam.md)): The total revenue opportunity available if a product achieved 100% market share, with SAM and SOM as narrower subsets.
- [Unique Selling Proposition](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/unique-selling-proposition) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/unique-selling-proposition.md)): Distinct competitive advantage or feature that makes a product or service stand out from competitors in a meaningful way to customers.
- [User Experience](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/user-experience-ux) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/user-experience-ux.md)): The overall experience of a person using a product, system, or service.
- [Value Proposition](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/value-proposition) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/value-proposition.md)): Clear statement that explains how a product or service solves customers' problems, delivers specific benefits, and why customers should choose it over competitors.
- [Viral Marketing](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/viral-marketing) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/viral-marketing.md)): Marketing strategy designed to encourage rapid content sharing across networks.
- [Word of Mouth](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/word-of-mouth) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/general/word-of-mouth.md)): Organic sharing of brand experiences between consumers.

### Platform Features

- [Connected TV](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/connected-tv-ctv) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/connected-tv-ctv.md)): Television content and advertising delivered through internet-connected devices and streaming platforms.
- [Dynamic Ads & Dynamic Product Ads (DPA)](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/dynamic-ads-dynamic-product-ads-dpa) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/dynamic-ads-dynamic-product-ads-dpa.md)): Automatically personalized ads that leverage user behavior data and product catalogs for relevant targeting.
- [Broad Match (Google Ads)](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/google-ads-broad-match) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/google-ads-broad-match.md)): Google Ads' loosest keyword match type. Modern broad match uses machine learning and Smart Bidding signals to match queries that share intent with the keyword — not just lexical variations.
- [Quality Score (Google Ads)](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/google-ads-quality-score) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/google-ads-quality-score.md)): Google Ads' 1-10 diagnostic score for each keyword, based on expected CTR, ad relevance, and landing page experience. Directly affects Ad Rank and CPC.
- [Google Discovery Ads](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/google-discovery-ads) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/google-discovery-ads.md)): Visually rich ads that appear in Google's personalized feeds.
- [Google Performance Max](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/google-performance-max) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/google-performance-max.md)): Google's AI-driven campaign type that runs across all Google inventory.
- [Instagram Reels](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/instagram-reels) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/instagram-reels.md)): Short-form vertical video format on Instagram for engaging content.
- [Lead Generation Forms](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/lead-gen-forms) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/lead-gen-forms.md)): Native in-platform forms for collecting lead information.
- [Learning Phase](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/learning-phase) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/learning-phase.md)): Critical optimization period when ad platforms gather performance data to train delivery algorithms.
- [LinkedIn Conversation Ads](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/linkedin-conversation-ads) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/linkedin-conversation-ads.md)): Interactive message-based ads that enable choose-your-path experiences.
- [Matched Audiences (LinkedIn)](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/linkedin-matched-audiences) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/linkedin-matched-audiences.md)): LinkedIn's audience-targeting suite for first-party data: upload company lists, contact email lists, retarget site visitors, or build lookalikes. The backbone of ABM on LinkedIn.
- [LinkedIn Sponsored Content](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/linkedin-sponsored-content) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/linkedin-sponsored-content.md)): Native ads that appear in LinkedIn members' feeds.
- [Lookalike Audiences](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/lookalike-audiences) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/lookalike-audiences.md)): Advanced targeting segments that use machine learning to find users similar to valuable customers.
- [Meta Advantage+ (formerly AAA)](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/meta-advantage-plus) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/meta-advantage-plus.md)): Meta's automated ad solution that uses machine learning to optimize creative and targeting.
- [Meta Catalog](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/meta-catalog) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/meta-catalog.md)): A container for product inventory that integrates with Meta ad solutions.
- [Meta Commerce Manager](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/meta-commerce-manager) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/meta-commerce-manager.md)): Centralized tool for managing e-commerce across Meta platforms.
- [Meta (Facebook) Ads Manager](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/meta-facebook-ads-manager) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/meta-facebook-ads-manager.md)): Centralized campaign management platform for advertising across Meta's family of apps.
- [Meta Reels Ads](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/meta-reels-ads) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/meta-reels-ads.md)): Vertical video ads that appear between and during Meta Reels content.
- [Meta Shopping](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/meta-shopping) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/meta-shopping.md)): Integrated e-commerce features across Meta platforms.
- [Google Ads Import for Microsoft Advertising](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/microsoft-ads-import-from-google-ads) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/microsoft-ads-import-from-google-ads.md)): Microsoft Advertising's native one-click import tool that copies campaigns, ad groups, keywords, ads, bids, negatives, and most extensions from a Google Ads account, with optional scheduled recurring sync.
- [LinkedIn Profile Targeting in Microsoft Advertising](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/microsoft-ads-linkedin-profile-targeting) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/microsoft-ads-linkedin-profile-targeting.md)): Microsoft Advertising's exclusive targeting feature, made possible by the 2016 LinkedIn acquisition, that lets advertisers layer Company, Industry, and Job Function bid modifiers onto Search and Audience Network campaigns using LinkedIn profile signals.
- [Microsoft Advertising (formerly Bing Ads)](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/microsoft-advertising) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/microsoft-advertising.md)): Microsoft's pay-per-click advertising platform spanning Bing, Yahoo, AOL, DuckDuckGo, Ecosia, and the Microsoft Audience Network, distinguished from Google Ads by native LinkedIn profile targeting and lower CPCs in most verticals.
- [Microsoft Audience Network](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/microsoft-audience-network) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/microsoft-audience-network.md)): Microsoft Advertising's native display, image, and video inventory served across MSN, Outlook.com, Microsoft Edge, Microsoft Start, Skype, and select partner properties — reaching hundreds of millions across the Microsoft ecosystem.
- [Pinterest Promoted Pins](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/pinterest-promoted-pins) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/pinterest-promoted-pins.md)): Pinterest's native ad format that looks like regular pins.
- [Pinterest Rich Pins](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/pinterest-rich-pins) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/pinterest-rich-pins.md)): Enhanced pins that automatically sync information from websites.
- [Pinterest Shopping](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/pinterest-shopping) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/pinterest-shopping.md)): Pinterest's integrated e-commerce features and solutions.
- [Pinterest Shopping Ads](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/pinterest-shopping-ads) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/pinterest-shopping-ads.md)): Product ads automatically created from merchant catalogs.
- [Pinterest Visual Search](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/pinterest-visual-search) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/pinterest-visual-search.md)): Pinterest's AI-powered image recognition technology for product discovery.
- [Promoted Posts](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/promoted-posts) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/promoted-posts.md)): Strategic amplification of organic social media content through paid distribution.
- [Responsive Display Ads](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/responsive-display-ads) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/responsive-display-ads.md)): Automatically generated display ads that adapt to available ad spaces.
- [Skippable Ads](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/skippable-ads) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/skippable-ads.md)): Video ads that balance advertiser messaging with user control through skip options.
- [Snap Ads](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/snap-ads) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/snap-ads.md)): Snapchat's full-screen vertical video ad format.
- [Snapchat Discover](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/snapchat-discover) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/snapchat-discover.md)): Snapchat's content platform featuring publisher and creator content.
- [Snapchat Dynamic Ads](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/snapchat-dynamic-ads) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/snapchat-dynamic-ads.md)): Product-focused ads that automatically update based on inventory and pricing.
- [Snapchat Story Ads](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/snapchat-story-ads) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/snapchat-story-ads.md)): Full-screen, immersive ad format within Snapchat Discover.
- [Story Ads](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/story-ads) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/story-ads.md)): Full-screen vertical ads on platforms that support ephemeral stories.
- [TikTok Ads](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/tiktok-ads) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/tiktok-ads.md)): TikTok's comprehensive advertising platform offering multiple ad formats and targeting capabilities.
- [TikTok Custom Audiences](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/tiktok-custom-audiences) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/tiktok-custom-audiences.md)): TikTok's audience targeting feature for retargeting and lookalike creation.
- [TikTok Spark Ads](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/tiktok-spark-ads) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/tiktok-spark-ads.md)): TikTok's native ad format that turns organic posts into ads.
- [YouTube Advertising](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/youtube-advertising) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/youtube-advertising.md)): Comprehensive video advertising platform offering multiple ad formats across the world's largest video network.
- [YouTube Shorts](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/youtube-shorts) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/youtube-shorts.md)): YouTube's vertical short-form video format and dedicated content ecosystem.
- [YouTube TrueView Ads](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/youtube-trueview-ads) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/platform/youtube-trueview-ads.md)): YouTube's skippable video ad format that charges advertisers only for engaged views.

### Chart Types

- [Area Chart](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/area-chart) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/area-chart.md)): A chart that displays quantitative data using the area between the line and axis to emphasize magnitude of values over time.
- [Box Plot](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/box-plot) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/box-plot.md)): A standardized way of displaying data distribution based on quartiles.
- [Bubble Chart](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/bubble-chart) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/bubble-chart.md)): A multi-variable chart that plots points with size representing a third variable.
- [Chord Diagram](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/chord-diagram) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/chord-diagram.md)): A circular visualization showing relationships between entities through arcs and curves.
- [Density Plot](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/density-plot) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/density-plot.md)): A smoothed representation of the distribution of a numeric variable.
- [Donut Chart](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/donut-chart) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/donut-chart.md)): A ring-shaped chart that displays proportional data with enhanced readability and nesting capabilities.
- [Funnel Chart](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/funnel-chart) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/funnel-chart.md)): A visualization that displays sequential data as it moves through a process, typically showing decreasing values at each stage.
- [Grouped Bar Chart](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/grouped-bar-chart) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/grouped-bar-chart.md)): A chart that displays multiple bars for each category to compare different metrics or groups side by side.
- [Heat Map](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/heat-map) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/heat-map.md)): A two-dimensional visualization using color intensity to represent values.
- [Histogram](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/histogram) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/histogram.md)): A chart that displays the distribution of continuous data using adjacent bars.
- [Horizontal Bar Chart](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/horizontal-bar-chart) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/horizontal-bar-chart.md)): A chart that uses horizontal bars of varying lengths to represent and compare data values across categories.
- [Line Chart](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/line-chart) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/line-chart.md)): A visualization that displays data points connected by straight lines to show trends and patterns over a continuous interval.
- [Network Graph](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/network-graph) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/network-graph.md)): A visualization of interconnected entities using nodes and edges.
- [Pie Chart](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/pie-chart) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/pie-chart.md)): A circular chart divided into sectors representing proportions of a whole.
- [Radar Chart](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/radar-chart) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/radar-chart.md)): A visualization that displays multivariate data as a two-dimensional chart with three or more quantitative variables.
- [Sankey Diagram](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/sankey-diagram) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/sankey-diagram.md)): A flow diagram where the width of arrows represents the quantity of flow.
- [Scatter Plot](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/scatter-plot) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/scatter-plot.md)): A chart that displays the relationship between two numeric variables.
- [Sparkline](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/sparkline) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/sparkline.md)): A small, word-sized data visualization that shows trends without axes or coordinates, designed for inline use.
- [Stacked Area Chart](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/stacked-area-chart) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/stacked-area-chart.md)): A variation of the area chart where multiple data series are stacked on top of each other to show both individual values and their contribution to the total.
- [Stacked Bar Chart](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/stacked-bar-chart) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/stacked-bar-chart.md)): A bar chart variation where bars are divided into segments that represent different components of a total.
- [Stream Graph](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/stream-graph) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/stream-graph.md)): A variation of stacked area chart with smooth, flowing curves and a centered baseline.
- [Treemap](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/treemap) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/treemap.md)): A hierarchical visualization using nested rectangles to show proportions.
- [Vertical Bar Chart](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/vertical-bar-chart) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/vertical-bar-chart.md)): A chart that uses vertical bars of varying heights to represent and compare data values across categories.
- [Word Cloud](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/word-cloud) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/glossary/charts/word-cloud.md)): A visual representation of text data where size represents frequency.
