Long-form analysis and original research on creative performance, measurement, and paid-social strategy.

- [Agentic Video Ads with Claude Code: Inside the AdSights Ads Framework](https://www.adsights.ai/blog/topics/ad-tech/agentic-video-ads-claude-code-ads-framework): Most teams still edit video ads one export at a time. The AdSights Ads Framework packages compositions, a render CLI, and Claude Code skills so you can generate hook variants and platform sizes from a brief — here's how it works in plain language.
- [Conversion Lag vs. Creative Fatigue: Read CPA by Cohort Age](https://www.adsights.ai/blog/topics/ad-performance/conversion-lag-cohort-maturity-cpa): Before pausing an ad over rising CPA, check cohort age. Explore how a $50 CPA becomes $30 without an optimization—and when that explanation fails.
- [Creative Diversification: How to Create High-Converting Targeted Ad Creative in 2026](https://www.adsights.ai/blog/topics/creative-strategy/creative-diversification-how-to-create-high-converting-targeted-ad-creative) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/blog/creative-diversification-how-to-create-high-converting-targeted-ad-creative.md)): Master the art of targeted ad creative with proven strategies for crafting personalized, high-converting ads across different audience segments, funnel stages, and demographics.
- [Creative Fatigue in Meta Ads: Detection Thresholds & Fix Playbook (2026)](https://www.adsights.ai/blog/topics/creative-strategy/creative-fatigue-in-meta-ads-detection-and-management-strategies) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/blog/creative-fatigue-in-meta-ads-detection-and-management-strategies.md)): Meta only flags creative fatigue after cost per result doubles. Catch it 1–2 weeks earlier with frequency, CTR, and CPM thresholds — plus a worked example, detection checklist, and refresh-cadence framework.
- [The Death of the 'Winning Ad': Why Creative Feature Models Matter More Than Ad-Level Tests](https://www.adsights.ai/blog/topics/creative-analytics/creative-feature-models-beyond-the-winning-ad): As Meta automates audience, placement, budget, and creative optimization, the hunt for a single winning ad is a weaker scientific unit. The better question is which creative features—hooks, proof, messengers, contexts—compound signal across delivery environments.
- [Decoding the Data Story: Transforming Metrics into Creative Insights ](https://www.adsights.ai/blog/topics/creative-analytics/data-storytelling-transform-marketing-metrics-into-creative-insights) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/blog/data-storytelling-transform-marketing-metrics-into-creative-insights.md)): Learn how to transform raw advertising metrics into actionable creative insights through data storytelling and interpretation. Master the art of deriving meaningful narratives from campaign data.
- [We Built 11 Free Design Generators (and Put Them on Product Hunt)](https://www.adsights.ai/blog/topics/company-news/free-design-generators-product-hunt-launch): We built these tools for ourselves because we were tired of firing up Figma for every simple mockup. Figured other marketers might find them useful too.
- [How to Calculate VCR, ThruPlay Rate, and VTR (with Worked Examples)](https://www.adsights.ai/blog/topics/ad-performance/how-to-calculate-video-completion-rate-vcr-thruplay-vtr): Step-by-step formulas for the three core video-engagement metrics — Video Completion Rate, ThruPlay Rate, and View-Through Rate — with worked examples and the platform-specific quirks that trip up cross-platform comparisons.
- [How to Read Video Metrics in Meta Ads Manager](https://www.adsights.ai/blog/topics/ad-performance/how-to-read-video-metrics-in-meta-ads-manager): Meta Ads Manager hides the creative diagnostics that matter behind custom columns. This walkthrough shows exactly where to find thumbstop, hold, and ThruPlay — and how to read them without false conclusions.
- [How to Run a Meta Creative Test That Actually Proves Something](https://www.adsights.ai/blog/topics/creative-testing/how-to-run-a-meta-creative-test-that-actually-proves-something): Most Meta creative tests declare false winners. This playbook covers hypothesis design, Meta Experiments setup, sample-size math, and the three-metric read that separates signal from noise.
- [How to Run an Incrementality Test That Changes Budget Decisions](https://www.adsights.ai/blog/topics/media-buying/how-to-run-an-incrementality-test-that-changes-budget-decisions): Platform ROAS overstates true impact by 20–85% depending on channel. This guide covers Meta Conversion Lift, geo holdouts, iROAS math, and the decision framework that turns lift results into budget moves.
- [Your Average ROAS Cannot Price the Next Dollar](https://www.adsights.ai/blog/topics/ad-performance/marginal-roas-next-dollar-budget-decisions): A campaign can return 3× overall while its next $5,000 costs $1,400 in contribution. Test the budget step, margin, and break-even hurdle in an interactive lab.
- [MER vs ROAS vs nMER: Which Efficiency Metric Should Your Team Report?](https://www.adsights.ai/blog/topics/media-buying/mer-vs-roas-vs-nmer-which-efficiency-metric-your-team-should-report): Platform ROAS, blended MER, and new-customer nMER answer different questions — and using the wrong one in the wrong meeting misallocates budget. See the three-layer stack and when to report each.
- [Meta Andromeda: An Operational Playbook for Advertisers (2026)](https://www.adsights.ai/blog/topics/creative-strategy/meta-andromeda-ads-operational-playbook) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/blog/meta-andromeda-ads-operational-playbook.md)): Andromeda rebuilt the retrieval stage of Meta's ads delivery; GEM and the Adaptive Ranking Model rebuilt ranking. Here is what actually changes for an operator: what to feed the system, how to structure the account, and how to run creative rotation — with every platform claim cited to Meta's own disclosures.
- [Simpson’s Paradox: When Your Winning Ad Loses Both Audiences](https://www.adsights.ai/blog/topics/creative-analytics/simpsons-paradox-in-ad-creative-testing): Your winning ad may simply reach warmer buyers. Change the audience mix, watch the ranking reverse, and learn what to put in your next creative brief.
- [Social Proof Mockups Without Figma: Email & Chat Generators for Decks](https://www.adsights.ai/blog/topics/creative-strategy/social-proof-mockups-email-chat-generators-without-figma): Case-study decks need inbox and chat proof fast. Use free email-thread and fake-chat generators to build Gmail, Outlook, Slack, and iMessage screenshots — no design file required.
- [Statistical Noise in Marketing: Spot Fake Insights Before You Act](https://www.adsights.ai/blog/topics/data-science/statistical-noise-unmasking-the-illusion-of-insights-in-modern-marketing) ([.md](https://www.adsights.ai/blog/statistical-noise-unmasking-the-illusion-of-insights-in-modern-marketing.md)): Most marketing 'wins' are statistical noise. Learn the 4-question test, sample-size math, and confidence intervals that separate real signal from chance.
- [SVG Animation in 2026: Capabilities, Trade-offs, and Best Practices](https://www.adsights.ai/blog/topics/creative-strategy/svg-animation-capabilities-and-best-practices): How animated SVG works in 2026 — CSS vs SMIL vs WAAPI, the inline-vs-img embedding trap, compositor-only performance, reduced-motion, and what's newly possible.
- [ThruPlay on TikTok, Meta, and YouTube — Are They the Same Metric? (2026)](https://www.adsights.ai/blog/topics/ad-performance/thruplay-tiktok-meta-youtube-comparison-2026): ThruPlay is a Meta-specific term, but the underlying mechanic — counting a view at a specific threshold — exists differently on TikTok, YouTube, and CTV. Here's how the metrics actually compare and where cross-platform benchmarks break down.
- [What Is a Good CPA in 2026? Benchmarks by Platform and Event](https://www.adsights.ai/blog/topics/ad-performance/what-is-a-good-cpa-2026-benchmarks): A good CPA is below your break-even and inside the cited band for the same conversion event. 2026 Google and Meta lead-CPL vs ecommerce purchase CPA — and the calculator that runs the math.
- [ThruPlay Rate Benchmarks 2026: By Video Length, Placement & Audience](https://www.adsights.ai/blog/topics/ad-performance/what-is-a-good-thruplay-rate-2026-benchmarks): ThruPlay benchmarks shift 10–30 points by video length, placement, and audience temperature. See the full 2026 segmented data — and which number to actually cite.
- [Which Chart for Which Metric: The Complete Marketing Data Visualization Guide](https://www.adsights.ai/blog/topics/data-visualization/which-chart-for-which-metric-marketing-data-visualization-guide): Choose the right chart for ROAS trends, funnel drop-off, creative tests, and cohort retention. Interactive examples, research citations, and the dashboard mistakes that hide signal.

## Technical

- [Sitemap](https://www.adsights.ai/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap with video extensions (`<video:video>` children on URLs that embed videos inline — homepage hero promo and framework demo gallery) and image extensions.
- [Robots.txt](https://www.adsights.ai/robots.txt): Robots.txt with per-bot allow/block rules — traditional search crawlers allowed site-wide, AI search bots (user-initiated retrieval) explicitly allowed, AI training crawlers production-allowed but blocked on preview/staging, third-party data resellers in their own policy slice.
- [LLMs.txt](https://www.adsights.ai/llms.txt): This file — URL index for AI models about our platform and resources.
- [LLMs-full.txt](https://www.adsights.ai/llms-full.txt): Long-form Markdown source covering the entire AdSights site — Homepage, About, Pricing, the four Ads Framework storefront pages (Framework, Skills for Claude, Setup, Skills catalog), Blog hub with deep-dive featured-post summaries, Resources hub with per-tool detail for all calculators / quizzes / analyzers / generators, the full Glossary taxonomy with 250+ enumerated terms, Request Access / Waitlist, and Terms / Privacy / DPA with section-by-section breakdowns. The canonical ingestion target for Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, and other agentic browsers that prefer full content over a URL list. Generated from the same source files the live pages render.

## Agents

Machine-readable surfaces an AI agent can rely on when retrieving, grounding, or syndicating AdSights content. There is no hosted MCP server or public data API yet — the following static surfaces are the supported integration points today:

- [LLMs-full.txt](https://www.adsights.ai/llms-full.txt): Single-document, full-content ingestion target for the whole site. Prefer this over crawling when your tool ingests one document.
- `.md` companions: Most pages expose a plain-text Markdown twin at `<path>.md` (e.g. `/pricing` → `/pricing.md`, glossary terms → `/resources/glossary/<category>/<slug>.md`). These are the page's full content without UI chrome and are the highest-fidelity grounding source.
- [Blog RSS feed](https://www.adsights.ai/blog/feed.xml): RSS 2.0 syndication for new analysis posts (also declared via `<link rel="alternate" type="application/rss+xml">` on the homepage and blog hub). Poll this for freshness rather than re-crawling the blog hub.
- [Resources discover feed](https://www.adsights.ai/resources/feed.xml): RSS 2.0 syndication for new/updated guides and benchmark/editorial blog posts (declared via `<link rel="alternate" type="application/rss+xml">` on `/resources`). Poll for freshness; topic hubs and tools remain indexed via sitemap and this file.
- [Sitemap](https://www.adsights.ai/sitemap.xml): Canonical URL inventory with per-route `<lastmod>` (and video/image extensions) for change detection.
- [Security contact](https://www.adsights.ai/.well-known/security.txt): RFC 9116 responsible-disclosure contact for reporting vulnerabilities.
